bio.text: Teri Ann Hourihan is the No Labels Party candidate for Arizona governor in 2026, after winning the party's July 21 primary.
KJZZ describes Hourihan as a Phoenix mental health counselor.

According to her candidate statement in the state voter education guide, she is an Arizona native, mother and small business owner, a licensed professional counselor since 2017, and earned a PhD in 2018.

sources.title: Underdog candidate bests well-funded opponent in Arizona's first No Labels gubernatorial primary
